parse.judge: MiMo as model behind the prompt

notes: A = jump, B = sword thrust; Control Cross = direction.
Wall-spring jump: cling to walls, press opposite direction + B to jump between walls.
Jump & Slash: press A and B during a jump (especially for enemies below).
Spiritual strength powers weapons: throwing star (B, 3 pts), fire wheel (B, 5 pts).
6 acts, 20 areas. Boss HP bar shown on screen. Timer runs out = lose a life.
